statement: On 2026-09-15 the US Senate holds a recorded roll-call vote on the CLARITY Act digital asset market structure bill (H.R. 3633 or its Senate vehicle) and the motion, whether cloture, motion to proceed, or passage, is agreed to.
resolution: True if senate.gov roll-call records show a vote dated 2026-09-15 on cloture, the motion to proceed, or passage of the CLARITY Act or its Senate market-structure vehicle, with a result of Agreed to or Passed. Otherwise false.
failure_condition: No Senate roll-call vote on the CLARITY Act or its Senate vehicle occurs on 2026-09-15, or the vote that occurs is rejected.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Between 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-30 a Ukrainian drone or missile strike causes fire or damage at an oil refinery inside internationally recognized Russian territory, acknowledged by a Russian governor, regional authority, or the operator, and claimed by the Ukrainian General Staff, SBU, or HUR.
resolution: True if, for a strike dated 2026-09-15 to 2026-09-30, a Russian governor, regional authority, or the operator acknowledges fire or damage at a named refinery in Russia and a Ukrainian military or intelligence body claims it. Otherwise false.
failure_condition: No Ukrainian strike between 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-30 produces Russian-acknowledged fire or damage at a refinery inside Russia.
